formula: Person / group / organisation + have / has / had no business + V-ing + other information

formulas.formula: Person / group / organisation + have / has / had no business + V-ing + other information

example: He has no business interfering in their marriage.
exampleZh: 他無權干涉他們的婚姻。

examples.en: He has no business interfering in their marriage.
examples.zh: 他無權干涉他們的婚姻。
examples.highlight: He has no business interfering in their marriage.

rules.zh: 你無權閱讀我的私人訊息。 該名記者無權作出那項指控。 該名前僱員不應進入辦公室。
rules.en: Change “have” according to the subject I / you / we / they + have no business he / she / singular noun + has no business past situations + had no business You have no business reading my private messages. The reporter has no business making that accusation. The former employee had no business entering the office.

rules.zh: 在 have no business 後面，使用動詞的 -ing 形式。在本課的目標句型中，不使用 to + verb。
rules.en: Use V-ing after “no business” has no business interfering ✓ has no business asking ✓ has no business being here ✓ has no business to interfere ✗

rules.zh: 在這個句型中，business 並非指「生意」或「公司」。意思是：【You have no right to ask that question.】 即「你無權問那個問題」或「那個問題輪不到你過問」。
rules.en: “Business” does not mean a company here You have no business asking that question. You have no right to ask that question. It is not your place to ask that question. You should not ask that question.

rules.zh: 這個句型通常帶有較強烈的批評、不滿或界線意識。你不應該閱讀她的訊息。 你根本無權閱讀她的訊息。 第二句的語氣較強，強調對方沒有適當權利或理由這樣做。
rules.en: The expression usually shows strong disapproval Compare: You should not read her messages. You have no business reading her messages.

rules.zh: 這個句型並不等於所有情況下的 should not。你不應吃太多糖。 這只是健康建議，一般不會改成：【You have no business eating too much sugar.】 除非說話者真的想強烈表示對方沒有資格或正當理由做該行為，否則句意便會不自然。
rules.en: Do not use it for every ordinary piece of advice You should not eat too much sugar. You have no business eating too much sugar.

rules.zh: 在【V-ing】後面可以加入受詞、副詞、介詞片語或其他資料。
rules.en: The V-ing phrase may contain more information asking personal questions entering the room without permission commenting on matters she knows nothing about using public money for private purposes telling other people how to live

rules.zh: 以下部分可以加在目標句型前後，但並非固定句型的一部分：【Without permission,...；In my opinion,...；Although he is the owner,...；I believe that...；The committee concluded that...；... without checking the facts；... whenever he likes；The core expression remains:】 該名訪客不應打開那些抽屜。 未經許可，該名訪客不應打開那些抽屜。 兩句都完整。第二句只是補充「未經許可」這項資料。
rules.en: Extra phrases are optional extensions Without permission,... In my opinion,... Although he is the owner,... I believe that... The committee concluded that... ... without checking the facts whenever he likes The core expression remains: have / has / had no business + V-ing Compare: The visitor has no business opening those drawers. Without permission, the visitor has no business opening those drawers.

rules.zh: 目標句型不一定每次都放在句子開頭。這些變化可以讓句式更自然，亦能避免學生只靠固定位置猜答案。
rules.en: The target expression can appear in different positions As the main clause The neighbour has no business interfering. After an introductory phrase Without permission, the neighbour has no business entering the flat. Inside a reporting clause I believe the neighbour has no business interfering. After a contrast or condition clause Although he owns the flat, the landlord has no business entering without notice.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以清楚表明某人正在干涉私人事務、作出不恰當行為，或做超出其權限的事情。鄰居無權教我們如何養育孩子。
benefits.en: It clearly establishes a boundary This structure makes it clear that someone is interfering in a matter that is private, inappropriate or outside their authority. The neighbour has no business telling us how to raise our children.

benefits.zh: 這個句型不只是給予建議，而是明確指出某個行為不恰當或缺乏正當理由。他不應透露她的私人資料。 他根本無權透露她的私人資料。
benefits.en: It expresses stronger criticism than “should not” Instead of merely giving advice, this structure shows that the action is improper or unjustified. Compare: He should not reveal her private information. He has no business revealing her private information.

benefits.zh: 你不需要每次都使用 It is not his place to... 等較長說法，也可以更直接地表達相同核心意思。
benefits.en: It gives you a concise alternative to longer expressions Instead of using a longer sentence such as “It is not his place to interfere”, you can express the same central idea more directly. It is not his place to interfere in their marriage. → He has no business interfering in their marriage.

benefits.zh: 這個句型特別適合討論個人界線、職場權限、機密資料、專業操守及公共責任。
benefits.en: It is useful when discussing rights, privacy and authority The structure is especially useful when talking about personal boundaries, workplace authority, confidential information, professional conduct and public responsibility.

benefits.zh: 在討論、辯論、投訴及議論文中，你可以使用這個句型明確批評不恰當的行為。公司無權在未經同意下收集個人資料。
benefits.en: It helps you express firm opinions in discussions You can use the structure to criticise an action clearly in discussions, debates, complaints and argumentative writing. A company has no business collecting personal data without permission.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以自然地放在引入片語、轉述動詞、讓步子句及條件句之後，讓句子更有變化，而不必每次都以人物作開頭。
benefits.en: It can fit naturally into longer sentence structures The expression can be placed after introductory phrases, reporting verbs, contrast clauses and conditional clauses.
